en-US.author: Hotovo s. r. o.
en-US.description: A platform for AI-powered software engineers.
en-US.longDescription: AiderDesk is a platform for AI-powered software engineers. It started as a desktop GUI for the Aider CLI and evolved into an orchestration layer with project and task management, Git worktrees, tool approval gates, multi-model support, extensions, and MCP integration.
en-US.name: AiderDesk
en-US.releaseNotes:
⚠️ Important Note for macOS Users: Due to our organization migration, the code signing certificate for macOS applications has been updated. As a result, automatic updates from previous versions will not apply to this release. Please download and install v0.91.0 manually. Subsequent releases will auto-update normally under the new signature.
Highlights
🌿 Fork Tasks from Pre-Compaction History
When long-running agent tasks hit their context token threshold and trigger compaction, you no longer have to lose access to the complete conversation history. Through the Undo dropdown, you can now fork a brand-new task starting from the exact state before compaction occurred, preserving your active task while allowing you to explore alternative directions with full initial context.
🔀 Smart Checkout with Uncommitted Changes
Switching branches with uncommitted work is now seamless with Smart Checkout. When local modifications prevent a standard git checkout, AiderDesk safely stashes your tracked and untracked changes, switches to the target branch, and automatically reapplies them. If merge conflicts arise, you are guided through conflict resolution directly in the app, with recovery backup branches preserved so your changes are never lost.
⚙️ Project-Level Aider Settings and Model Defaults
You can now configure Aider settings and model defaults on a per-project basis. Customize your Main, Weak, and Architect models, reasoning effort, and CLI flags per project with clean inheritance from your global settings. Projects automatically select their assigned defaults when created, making it easy to use specialized models or configurations for different codebases.
🔗 Interactive File Links in Messages
File references in assistant messages and tool outputs are now clickable, interactive links. When working in the desktop app, clicking a file opens it directly in your default editor or file manager. When using the browser client, you can quickly download the file or copy its workspace-relative path to your clipboard with a single click.
⚡ Faster Browser Startup with Loading Progress
Web and remote browser client startup has received a major overhaul. Asset bundles are now minified, compressed with gzip and brotli, and cached for snappy repeat visits. During initial connection, a dedicated startup screen shows live download progress with automatic retry controls, ensuring a reliable boot even over slower network connections.
Other Changes
- Git & Security:
  - Prevented OS command injection via commit messages and file paths in git operations.
  - Resolved race conditions from concurrent git mutations on a single repository with unified repo-level locking, and made worktree uncommitted-changes recovery preserve both change sets.
- Terminal:
  - Fixed terminal startup cleanup and retries, cancelling abandoned initializations and waiting for the fitted emulator before creating shell sessions (Thanks @vincentkoc).
  - Fixed terminal text input on Wayland with IBus while preserving keyboard and composition handling.
- Task & Browser Performance:
  - Prevented request timeouts for long-running browser prompts and task operations while keeping CLI streaming responsive.
  - Eliminated database errors during application shutdown by waiting for project and task cleanup to complete.
- Observability:
  - Fixed Langfuse Cloud agent tracing by migrating to OpenTelemetry ingestion and ensuring traces flush on app shutdown.
- Extensions & UI:
  - Added a reusable SplitButton component with additional-action menus and support for UI extensions.
  - Safely render non-JSON subagent tool results to prevent UI display issues.
  - Added payload data support for log message actions while preserving existing action handlers.
- Internationalization:
  - Added Italian locale support (Thanks @andrea66simonetti).
🧩 Extensions
- Cursor SDK: JSON-encoded task error results for cleaner and safer error handling.
💡 We'd love your feedback and contributions! Found a bug, have an idea, or want to submit a PR? Help us make AiderDesk even better on GitHub. Happy coding! 🚀
